title: release cutover checklist - daily scratchpad (2026-03-10)
content:
Context:
- Release: 2026-03-10 production cutover for platform v1.12.0 (includes KV cache fix + autoscaler tuning).
- Owners: Liam Chen (cutover lead), Aisha Kumar (DB/infra), Jordan Park (runtime), Samira Voss (monitoring & comms).
- Primary rollback window: 30 minutes after traffic migration; full rollback plan below.

High-level timeline (local times):
- 09:15 - pre-cutover sync (15m) - confirm green on all prechecks.
- 09:30 - start maintenance page rollout to 5% (canary).
- 09:35 - apply DB migrations (backfill safe order) - Aisha.
- 09:50 - deploy runtime changes to canary pool (5 GPUs) - Jordan.
- 10:05 - run smoke tests / synthetic load (10m) - Samira.
- 10:20 - ramp to 25% traffic (monitor 10m).
- 10:35 - ramp to 75% traffic (monitor 15m).
- 11:00 - full traffic migration.
- 11:30 - post-cutover validation / remove maintenance page.

Pre-cutover quick checklist (must be green before 09:30):
- [ ] All CI checks passing for release branch (PR #1829).
- [ ] Nightly canary health metrics stable for 24h.
- [ ] Database backup taken and verified (snapshot id: rinf-prod-snap-20260309).
- [ ] Pager rota and escalation list updated (oncall: aisha).
- [ ] Burn-in tests on staging with 95th latency < 120ms.

Code & backports:
- Backports required:
  - rinf-runtime: fix-kv-cache-eviction -> backport to v1.11.x (JIRA-RINF-2109) - assigned to Jordan.
  - autoscaler: fix-burst-threshold -> included in release branch already.
- PRs to watch: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/1829 (main release).
- Merge blockers: none flagged, but waiting on infra approval for new kernel.

Runtime deployment steps (Jordan):
- 1) Deploy image rinf-runtime:v1.12.0-canary to canary pool with 5 GPU nodes.
- 2) Verify KV cache warmup metrics (cache hit rate > 70% after 10m).
- 3) Check per-node GPU memory usage; ensure < 85%.
- 4) If OOMs or increased 5xx > 0.5% rollback immediately to rinf-runtime:v1.11.6.

DB migration (Aisha):
- Migration script: db/migrations/20260310_add_kv_index.sql (non-blocking).
- Run in migration-transaction mode, validate row counts.
- Post-migration verification: sample query latency < 50ms.

Monitoring & alerts (Samira):
- Dashboards to watch: Cutover Overview, KV Cache, Autoscaler, Token latency heatmap.
- Key metrics and thresholds:
  - 95th token latency > 250ms -> alert page and pause ramp.
  - Error rate (5xx) > 0.5% -> pause and investigate.
  - Autoscaler thrash (scale up/down > 3 times in 10m) -> roll back autoscaler change.
- Synthetic smoke suite: smoke/cutover/smoke-suite (run after canary deploy).

Comms plan:
- Slack: #prod-cutovers (primary), #oncall (escalation).
- Customer comms: only if service-affecting > 5 minutes or data loss. Draft msg in Confluence.
- Exec update: send brief at +60m with summary of success and any open items.

Rollback plan (if critical):
- Criteria to trigger: sustained 95th latency > 300ms OR 5xx > 1% for 10m OR data integrity issue.
- Steps:
  - Pause traffic migration (redirect back to last known-good pool).
  - Trigger deploy to previous image rinf-runtime:v1.11.6 using deploy rollback playbook.
  - Restore DB from snapshot if migration caused corruption (coordinate with Aisha) - note: can be destructive, escalate to Eng leads.
  - Notify #prod-cutovers and execs.

Post-cutover tasks (within 24h):
- [ ] Validate long-tail latency with full traffic for 4h.
- [ ] Run nightly regression evals against key prompt sets.
- [ ] Close JIRA-RINF-2147 and update release notes.
- [ ] Capture postmortem if any P1/P2 incidents.

Open Questions / TODOs (personal):
- Check with infra if kernel selection changes require driver bump (Jordan).
- Confirm the autoscaler policy uses new heuristics or falls back to old thresholds (Aisha).
- Add small synthetic that exercises long-context responses (Samira).

Notes to self:
- Keep the maintenance page message minimal and include ETA.
- If we see KV cache cold starts after deploy, allow 15m for warmup before deciding rollback.
- Keep close eye on cost metrics during ramp (unexpected spike could indicate looping requests).

Quick contacts:
- Aisha Kumar (pager): +1-555-0102, slack @aisha.k
- Jordan Park (pager): +1-555-0103, slack @jordan.p
- Samira Voss (monitoring): +1-555-0104, slack @samira.v

End of scratchpad. Will update during cutover with timestamps and notes.
